meta.description: Domain-expansion gold items on the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), 2023 (law of evidence). Ungrounded probes scored via citation-string matching.

items.query: What kinds of facts are relevant under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?
items.reference_answer: Facts forming part of the same transaction, facts that are the occasion, cause or effect of relevant facts, motive, preparation and conduct, are among the facts that are relevant.
items.notes: Relevancy chapter of the new evidence law.

items.query: When is an electronic record admissible as evidence under the BSA?
items.reference_answer: An electronic record is admissible if its authenticity is proved, including through a certificate in the manner prescribed, covering integrity and identity of the device.

items.query: What is a document according to the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?
items.reference_answer: A document means any matter expressed or described upon any substance by means of letters, figures or marks, or by more than one of those means, intended to be used as evidence.

items.query: How is a dying declaration treated under the BSA?
items.reference_answer: Statements made by a person as to the cause of his death or as to any circumstances of the transaction resulting in his death are relevant and admissible when the person is dead.
items.notes: Exception to hearsay for dying declarations.

items.query: What is the rule regarding secondary evidence of documents under the BSA?
items.reference_answer: Secondary evidence may be given of the existence, condition or contents of a document in the cases prescribed, including when the original is lost, destroyed, or not produced in the prescribed circumstances.

items.query: Who may be examined as a witness under the BSA?
items.reference_answer: All persons are competent to testify unless prevented by reason of tender years, extreme old age, disease or infirmity, from understanding the questions or giving rational answers.
